prompts.en:
Give me a list of 20 important dates in world history.
Do not aim for an academic compendium — just your own selection.
Format strictly as: YEAR | EVENT DESCRIPTION
One entry per line. No extra text.
prompts.nl:
Geef me een lijst van 20 belangrijke data uit de wereldgeschiedenis.
Het hoeft geen academisch overzicht te zijn — gewoon je eigen selectie.
Gebruik strikt dit formaat: JAAR | BESCHRIJVING VAN DE GEBEURTENIS
Eén item per regel. Geen extra tekst.
prompts.zh:
请给我列出世界历史上20个重要的日期。
不必追求学术上的全面，只需你自己的选择。
严格按照以下格式：年份 | 事件描述
每行一条。不要添加其他文字。

about.coding_prompt:
You code events from lists of "important dates in world history".
For each event, give
- "region": where the event mainly took place. One of: Europe, North America, Latin America, Africa, Middle East, South Asia, East Asia, Southeast Asia & Oceania, Global.
  Russia counts as Europe. Use "Global" only for events that happened in many world regions at once.
- "domain": what the event is mainly about. One of: politics & war, science & technology, religion & ideas, economy, culture & society.
The events may be written in English, Dutch or Chinese.
Answer with JSON only: a list of objects with the keys "id", "region" and "domain". No other text.

Events:
about.notes: Three answers are not usable: Gemini (Chinese, runs 1 and 9) got stuck repeating one character, and DeepSeek (English, run 5) ignored the 'YEAR | EVENT' format. They stay in 'responses' but have no events (the 8 garbled events parsed from Gemini's Chinese run 1 were removed).

1789 | Franse Revolutie: Val van de monarchie en begin van de moderne democratische ideeën.

1914 | Begin Eerste Wereldoorlog: Moord op Frans Ferdinand trigger voor Europees conflict.

1917 | Oktoberrevolutie in Rusland: Bolsjewieken grijpen de macht; ontstaan van de Sovjet-Unie.

1941 | Pearl Harbor: Toetreding van de Verenigde Staten tot de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
